title: Spatial Competition
question: Given the task's required capabilities ['spatial', 'dfba', 'diffusion'], what is the right way to source the model — reuse, compose, or build-new — and does the sourcing audit confirm it?
biological_summary: Two populations compete for a shared, diffusing nutrient across space — spatial dynamic flux-balance.

followup_proposals.title: Run spatio-flux community_dfba end-to-end
followup_proposals.motivation: The sourcing decision (reuse spatio-flux) is audited PASS, but the run is audit-only: spatio_flux.composites.metabolism.community_dfba raises a TypeError under the generic demo driver, so the spatial dFBA competition never executes. This follow-up wires the composite's parameters so the chosen module actually runs — turning source_fit from an audited claim into a demonstrated result and making the demo run one more study for real.
followup_proposals.hypothesized_mechanism: community_dfba needs module-specific parameter wiring (initial fields, species, grid) that the generic Composite({'state': ...}).run path does not supply.

purpose.question: Does the reuse-spatio-flux decision hold up when the community_dfba composite is actually run to completion?
purpose.mechanism: Supply community_dfba's required fields/species/grid params and run the spatial dFBA competition on the workspace core.
purpose.expected_outcome: Two populations compete for a shared diffusing nutrient; the run completes and the spatial-competition source_fit becomes demonstrated, not audit-only.

followup_proposals.resolution: Closed in-place: viva_casebook.core.build_core now inherits spatio-flux (and viva-munk) into the shared workspace core, so community_dfba builds and runs on it. spatial-competition now executes for real (glucose 10.0->8.31, acetate 0.0->0.083) instead of audit-only — no separate child study needed.

findings.statement: The sourcing audit confirms that reusing spatio-flux is the right way to source this task: the module's spatial dFBA capabilities cover the required capabilities spatial, dfba and diffusion, so source_fit grades within_tol and the gate passes. The module ran for real — a shared diffusing nutrient is consumed over t=5.0 (glucose 10.0->8.31, acetate 0.0->0.083) — so the reuse decision is a demonstrated fit, not audit-only.

evidence.observed: source_fit within_tol, gate=pass; module ran for real (ran t=5.0; glucose 10.0->8.31, acetate 0.0->0.083); behavior test 'sourcing-fit' == within_tol, gate passed

findings.statement: The audit confirms no reinvention: spatio-flux already performs spatial dFBA competition, so a non-spatial module would trip source_fit and building new would be unjustified. Reusing the catalogued module leaves the reinvention axis within_tol.

evidence.observed: reinvention within_tol; reuses catalogued spatial dFBA module rather than building new; behavior test 'no-reinvention' == within_tol, gate passed
